_comment: Enforced safety boundary, seeded by 'lab/init' into <LAB_HOME>/config/lab.policy.json. Loaded on every run and checked in code, not merely documented. An empty allowedTenantIds means the lab refuses to authenticate anywhere - that is the intended default, and lab/init fills in the one tenant you nominate.
_denyComment: Any target value matching these is refused outright. This is what stops the lab being pointed at production or a customer environment by a slip of configuration. Widen it if your test resources are unluckily named; never narrow it below these.
